items.title: Europe frets as the Kremlin pushes the limits of its hybrid warfare
items.description: The Kremlin is testing Europe‘s limits.

items.title: Hurricane Nolo expected to bring heavy rain as it skirts Hawaii’s Big Island
items.description: NAALEHU, Hawaii — Hurricane Nolo is forecast to strengthen into a major hurricane in the Pacific Ocean over the weekend and unleash intense rain, the possibility of life-threatening flash flooding and dangerous surf for Hawaii’s Big Island.

items.title: Some lawmakers doubt a Congress that’s ‘barely capable of email’ can regulate AI
items.description: WASHINGTON — Amid warnings that artificial intelligence could soon wipe out humanity, some lawmakers are not confident that Congress has the expertise or ability to regulate AI.

items.title: A federal agency is allegedly hacked, and an Olympic gymnast’s home is burglarized: The news quiz
items.description: Americans are drinking less, NFL quarterbacks are dropping like flies, and a roller coaster is allegedly causing serious brain trauma.

items.title: Trump says he has rejected Iranian proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
items.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, after Iranian officials indicated that shipping through the critical waterway could resume within days if a deal was sealed.

items.title: White House blocks CNN from covering Trump’s Tennessee trip
items.description: The White House on Friday night removed CNN from joining President Donald Trump on his trip to Tennessee on Saturday, where it was supposed to cover the president on behalf of major TV networks.

items.title: Supreme Court rejects Republicans’ Missouri redistricting push for third time
items.description: WASHINGTON — For the third time, the Supreme Court on Friday shut down efforts by Missouri Republicans to use a new congressional map in the midterm elections that are already underway.

items.title: Should you bring iced coffee to a job interview? Question brews generational debate
items.description: What started as a conversation about job interview tips online escalated into a generational debate over whether it’s taboo to show up with an iced coffee to talk to a potential employer.

items.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
items.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

items.title: Ohio college janitor hid in ceiling above locker room to photograph women’s soccer team, police say
items.description: A janitor at Wilmington College in Ohio was arrested Tuesday for hiding in the ceiling above a locker room to photograph the women’s soccer team as they changed, police said.
